notes.title: [Devlog 8/20/2019]
notes.content:
Hello again mercs! Art seems to be my life right now, but, got some new fun things to show off! Worked on a new race called the Uhlanga. The Uhlanga are a race of fish people, look forward to playing with them next update. Also been working on some side missions, look forward to some teasers for that next week.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35122808/bc451102fe98fd152c5f82dcced1ce92f32d853b.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35122808/345dc00d8caf9741052b543ad53607d1af6ab298.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Worked on:[/h1]
[list]
[*] More art assets
[*] Work on side missions
[*] New playable race, The Uhlanga.
[/list]

We have also created a community discord! Join us and pester the devs directly, or chat with your fellow mercs.

Join: https://discord.gg/Xjmqngk

See you next week!

notes.title: Devlog 7/31/2019
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Mercs![/h1]

I will now be posting a weekly devlog describing what I have been working on the past week. 

This week I have been working on creating assets for the next part of the main story, mostly NDF tiles since it will be NDF themed.

[h1]Worked on:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Several new tile maps for NDF (Kasha) themed locations, Tiles for Prefab structures in the NDF style, both FG and BG tiles.
[*] New NDF weapon, the Flak Gun. A shotgun like weapon that fires ricocheting projectiles that rip though targets
[*] Glow system for map props, nice for fancy lights
[/list]

See you next week!

notes.title: Update: Shadows of Anubis!
notes.content:
Proud to release a new update featuring a new Main Story area, The Anubis Tomb world!
After Talking to Thoriden, Leader of the Asguardians, he sends you to Anubis to find his friend, Tyr.

[b]Explore the sprawling cryo-tombs looking for Tyr and treasure.[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35122808/752e372d5e22f1d96e48df81573bcc5b64a7f73a.png[/img]

[b]Find amazing secrets.[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35122808/d88217d3ed95c1ebef755916bff19c2a7e20f272.png[/img]

[b]And deal with the shadowy Osiris.[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35122808/a5bb220629efac353bc6559bb1f2569555eda623.png[/img]

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Finished the Anubis Tomb World
[*] New enemies
[*] New Items
[*] New Boss
[*] Various bug fixes
[/list]

Steam Build: 4040355
